ruling:ability-score-respec.name: ability-score-respec
ruling:ability-score-respec.notes: Standing table exception, ONE-TIME only for Chadickith; not RAW and not a legal point-buy, so record it as a house exception (./dm memory add 'Ruling: Chadickith ability scores respecced once (table exception) ...' --type rule) and do not repeat for others without a new check. Final scores STR 17 DEX 9 CON 14 INT 10 WIS 10 CHA 12. Mods now STR +3 DEX -1 CON +2 INT 0 WIS 0 CHA +1 (total +5, was +7; net nerf). Apply while at full HP with no Vital Sacrifice or Beast/Hybrid Form active if possible. Recompute everything: (1) Max HP: CON mod drops 3 to 2 retroactively, -1 per level = -5, so 55 -> 50 (level 5, average HP per level; if a Vital Sacrifice reduction is active, lower the normal max by 5 and keep the reduction); current HP cannot exceed new max; 5d12 hit dice unchanged. (2) Natural Armor AC = 12 + CON = 14 (was 15; no shield or armor in play). (3) Rite save DC = 8 + PB 3 + CON 2 = 13 (sheet feature text says 14, stale; old value was 14). (4) Saves use the SHEET proficiencies, which are CON and CHA (not STR and CON as the brief said; fix the sheet or confirm with the player): CON save +5, CHA save +4, STR save +3, DEX save -1, INT 0, WIS 0. (5) Initiative -1 (was +1). (6) Attacks: STR weapons (greataxe, unarmed, hybrid talons) to-hit +3 STR +3 PB = +6, damage +3 (unchanged; Strike of the Giants unchanged). Hand crossbow DEX -1: to-hit +2, 1d6-1 (was +4, 1d6+1). Beast Form talons use beast stats per sheet: recheck. (7) Skills: Athletics +6 (unchanged), Investigation +3 (+1), Arcana +3 (+1), Intimidation +4 (+1), Survival +3 (-1), Perception unproficient +0 (passive 10, was 11), Stealth etc DEX -1. Feral Senses add Rite Die as before. (8) Sinister Insight CON check is +2 plus proficiency only if proficient; DC 8+CR unchanged. (9) Grappler (2024) prerequisite STR or DEX 13+ still met via STR 17; Powerful Build and carrying rules unaffected (no encumbrance). Update the sheet with the engine (./dm pc commands) and record the change; do not narrate stat numbers in NPC speech (no-meta-mechanics).
ruling:ability-score-respec.cite: Table exception (rule of cool, player-requested, DM-approved); PHB p.12-13 (scores, modifiers); PHB p.177 (CON and HP); not RAW

ruling:ability-score-respec-base.name: ability-score-respec-base
ruling:ability-score-respec-base.notes: Supersedes the final-scores reading of ability-score-respec. ONE-TIME custom base array STR 17/DEX 9/CON 14/INT 10/WIS 12/CHA 12 (not legal point-buy or standard array; table exception) PLUS Loxodon CON+2 WIS+1 (Dodrud variant is cosmetic, memory m0005) PLUS Grappler STR+1 (level 4). FINALS: STR 18 (+4), DEX 9 (-1), CON 16 (+3), INT 10 (+0), WIS 11 (+0), CHA 12 (+1). None above 20 cap. NOTE base WIS must be 12 (not the sheet's 10): 12+1=11 is wrong math, it is 12+1=13 unless base WIS was 10; the DM-stated expected WIS 11 requires base WIS 10 + 1. Use WIS 11 as the player-confirmed final. DERIVED UPDATES: STR mod +4: greataxe, hybrid talons, unarmed (trunk) to-hit +7 (4+PB3); greataxe 1d12+4 (+GWF), hybrid talons 1d6+4 (Rite Die), unarmed trunk damage 1+4 = 5 bludgeoning; Athletics +7 (proficient); STR save +4; Grappler grapple escape DC 8+3+4 = 15; trunk lift 5x18 = 90 lb. CON mod +3: max HP 55 = 12+3 first level, +4 levels x (7+3) (d12 avg 7, CON retroactive per level; engine HP already CON-adjusted); current HP and the Vital Sacrifice reduction track from the new max (add +5 to normal max; do not heal Vital Sacrifice loss); AC 15 (12+CON, no armor); Rite DC 14 (8+PB3+CON3); CON save +6 (proficient); concentration saves n/a. WIS 11 (+0): passive Perception 10 (plus Rite Die with Feral Senses when applicable), Survival +3 (proficient, +Rite Die by sight/hearing/smell). DEX 9 unchanged: initiative -1, hand crossbow +2 to hit, 1d6-1; Beast Form talons use beast statistics (giant owl STR/DEX), unchanged. INT 10, CHA 12 unchanged (CHA save +6 proficient: 3+1 = +4, no change). Verify sheet: CHA save is proficient, +4. Do not apply the bonuses twice: the sheet currently holds the earlier final values 17/9/14/10/10/12, so overwrite with 18/9/16/10/11/12 once.
ruling:ability-score-respec-base.cite: GGR p.17 (Loxodon CON +2, WIS +1); XPHB Grappler (+1 STR, house-allowed 2024 feat); PHB p.12-13, p.177; table exception, not RAW
